title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler’s Tour Championship Win
items.text: Scottie Scheffler ended his 2026 PGA Tour season with a superb win at the Tour Championship last Sunday.

items.headline: Casey Leads Omega Masters
items.text: Paul Casey leads the Omega European Masters by three strokes heading into the final round on Sunday.

items.headline: Walker Cup Sunday Tee Times
items.text: Great Britain and Ireland lead the USA 6.5-5.5 at the 2026 Walker Cup; morning foursome tee times set at Lahinch.
